headnotes.la: …udii discalcearetur. Ideo Moses discalceari jubetur, nec ad Ecclesiam, quae in rubo significatur, quasi sponsus accedat calceatus; hoc enim Christo servandum, qui verus est sponsus. De quo Joannes ait
headnotes.en: …s bidden to be unshod, and not to approach shod, as a bridegroom, to the Church, which is signified in the bramble; for this is to be reserved for Christ, who is the true bridegroom. Of whom John says
